name: JW Marriott Edmonton ICE Disctrict
insider_take: Located in the heart of Edmonton's vibrant ICE District, this sleek tower puts you steps away from world-class hockey and concerts while offering stunning views of the North Saskatchewan River valley.
whats_special: This is Edmonton's first JW Marriott and sits directly above the pedway system connecting Rogers Place arena. The hotel features floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing the dramatic prairie skyline, and its rooftop terrace offers unparalleled views of the river valley - one of North America's largest urban park systems.
pro_tip: Book a river valley-facing room on higher floors for breathtaking sunrise views, and use the climate-controlled pedway system to explore downtown without braving Edmonton's famous winter temperatures.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location means you're walking distance to the Royal Alberta Museum, Canada's largest museum, and just minutes from the historic Old Strathcona district. During hockey season, catch an Edmonton Oilers game at Rogers Place literally next door, or explore the extensive underground pedway network that connects 50+ city blocks.
pros: Prime location in Edmonton's vibrant ICE District entertainment hub
Luxury JW Marriott brand with premium amenities and service
Modern, newly constructed property with contemporary design
Walking distance to Rogers Place arena and downtown attractions
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury brand positioning
Urban location may experience downtown noise levels
